mechanism_card.hypothesis: Replacing the near-catalogue collar with spaced ancestor-supported dots modestly improves coverage of unmapped fault segments.
mechanism_card.mechanism: Remove only 2171 dots at catalogue distances (2,3] px, preserving all other R0 locations. Refill away from catalogue at the same count and >=2.8 px spacing from retained/new dots. This reallocates the narrow mapped-trace halo to existing ancestor ridge support, without adding a new physical signal.
mechanism_card.non_fault_mimic: Ancestor ridge support may represent erosional channels, lithologic boundaries or alluvial fan margins rather than tectonic scarps.
mechanism_card.alternative: The removed collar may contain unmapped parallel splays or newly mapped geometry of known systems; then widening the collar loses useful coverage.
mechanism_card.falsifier: A receipt change <=-0.01 versus a receipted R0 rejects the predicted benefit on public chunks; abs(change)<0.01 is no evidence. Neither identifies private truth.
mechanism_card.confounder: Refill support/ranking is necessary to hold count fixed; the result tests collar-plus-fixed-refill policy, not distance alone.
